description: Invitation Homes Inc. is a leading owner and operator of single-family homes for lease, offering residents high-quality homes in sought-after neighborhoods across the United States, and as of December 31, 2025 it wholly owned 86,192 homes for lease, jointly owned 8,006 homes for lease, and provided professional third-party property and asset management services for an additional 15,866 homes, all of which are primarily located in 16 core markets across the country. It operates in markets with strong demand drivers, high barriers to entry and high rent growth potential, primarily in the Western United States, Florida and the Southeast United States, and provides residents access to updated homes with features they value, as well as close proximity to jobs and good schools. Its property operations encompass in-house local market management and the execution of marketing, leasing, resident relations and maintenance functions through a highly scalable, vertically integrated, resident-centric property management service platform referred to as ProCare, with all property management functions internally managed since its founding in 2012.
